changes.evidence: Randolph stayed on Earth centuries ago when the Asgardian host went home and has lived as a human since; he has no tie to Asgard in any episode he is in (ep 8, ep 46). Asgard is backstory. (If the M change below is also accepted, combined list: [[University of Seville, AoS S1],[Independent, AoS S1]].)

At the end of ep 8 (S1E8) Randolph decides it is time to leave Seville and Coulson suggests he move to Portland; in ep 46 (S3E2) he is found in a Norway jail cell, not at the university. No stage records him leaving Seville.

Enoch is a Chronicom observer sent by his people to study Earth; in ep 88 (S4E22) and S5 he works with his own hired squad, not S.H.I.E.L.D. In S6E3 the Chronicom Hunters decommission him; in the S6 finale (S6E13) he turns on the Hunters to save FitzSimmons and from then on works with S.H.I.E.L.D. (wiki infobox: S.H.I.E.L.D., Chronicom Hunters undercover formerly). 'S.H.I.E.L.D. from the start' is wrong for S4-S5.

The recreated Flint (from S6E12) is taken in by S.H.I.E.L.D., guards the module with Piper in the S7 finale, and a year later is enrolled at S.H.I.E.L.D.'s Coulson Academy studying under May (wiki infobox for this Flint: S.H.I.E.L.D., Coulson Academy). Owner may prefer the group name 'Coulson Academy'.
Sousa served in the U.S. Army's 28th Infantry in WWII and lost his leg at Bastogne; he is already a discharged veteran working at the SSR in 1946 when Agent Carter begins. Army is backstory.
Jarvis was dishonorably discharged from the British Army during WWII before becoming Howard Stark's butler; by Agent Carter S1 he is only Stark's man. British Army is backstory.
Thompson's Navy service (Iwo Jima, Okinawa, Navy Cross) is WWII backstory; by 1946 he is an SSR agent when Agent Carter S1 begins.
Dooley served as a U.S. Army officer in WWII and came home after the war; in Agent Carter S1 he is chief of the New York SSR only. Army is backstory.
Wilkes was a U.S. Navy engineer in WWII, then joined Isodyne after the war; in Agent Carter S2 he is an Isodyne scientist. Navy is backstory.

End of ep 9 (S1E9): the Watcher sends the Guardians back to their home universes and the team breaks up; T'Challa goes home and is back with his Ravagers, teaching Peter Quill to use a blaster. Wiki infobox: Ravagers (current), Guardians of the Multiverse (formerly).
End of ep 9 (S1E9): the Guardians are sent home and break up; Thor goes back to his universe and reunites with Jane. Wiki infobox: Asgard (current), Guardians of the Multiverse (formerly).

Ep 13 (S2E4): Gamora is sent by Thanos to kill Tony Stark, then turns against her father and kills him (a defection). Ep 9 (S1E9): she joins the Guardians, and at the end the team is sent home and breaks up; she goes back to her universe and Iron Man. Wiki infobox: Guardians of the Multiverse (formerly), no current group. The group name for Thanos' side is a placeholder for the owner.

End of ep 9 (S1E9): with no world to go back to, the Watcher sends Natasha to the universe that lost its Natasha (the 'Avengers Assassinated' universe); Fury asks her to join that world's new Avengers against the Asgardian invasion. Wiki infobox: Guardians of the Multiverse (formerly), Avengers of that universe (current).

owner_calls.question: In ep 46 (S3E2) Coulson pressures Randolph into helping S.H.I.E.L.D. with the Monolith on one mission (wiki infobox: S.H.I.E.L.D. formerly). Add a S.H.I.E.L.D. stage for S3?
owner_calls.evidence: Coulson threatens to expose him to the ATCU and the press, so he reluctantly helps get Simmons back, then has no further ties.

owner_calls.question: In What If...? S3E7 (ep 25) the Eminence captures Carter, and Ultron rescues her in S3E8 before she dies. Record a captive stage?
options: Add [Watchers (captive), What If...? S3] then [Guardians of the Multiverse, What If...? S3]
owner_calls.evidence: Wikipedia S3E7: 'Carter resolves to meet with Infinity Ultron alone, only to be captured by the Eminence.' S3E8: 'The Watcher and Carter are rescued by Ultron'; Carter then gives her life. Capture and rescue both fall in the same season title.
